cases.persona: Sam, a 3-payment plan money on hand pays (invented, D-68)
cases.situation: November so far: $3,000 in on the 1st, bills $1,500 paid, $500 of everyday spending, so $500 more is still to come this month. On 15 November 2026 Sam has $4,000 in the everyday account and a $2,000 safety net (its full size, locked, the default) in savings. Sam looks at a $1,800 laptop on a 0% plan: 3 payments of $600, the first today (15 November), then 15 December and 15 January.
cases.why: Money in this month: $3,000 (1 November). Already spent: $1,500 of bills and $500 of everyday spending. Still to come: $500 of everyday spending by 30 November. So this month has $500 left ($3,000 - $1,500 - $500 - $500), and the spare money is $4,000 - $500 still to come = $3,500, of which $3,000 is from earlier months.
